proof_body:
by
  intro a p q r h
  have h1 : a 1 = p + q + r := by
    have e := h 1 le_rfl
    rw [Finset.Icc_self, Finset.sum_singleton] at e
    rw [e]
    push_cast
    ring
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → a (m + 1) = p * (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1) + q := by
    intro m hm
    have e1 := h (m + 1) (by omega)
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), h m hm] at e1
    push_cast at e1
    linear_combination e1
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
    have e1 := hd 1 le_rfl
    have e2 := hd 2 (by norm_num)
    have k1 := key 1 le_rfl
    have k2 := key 2 (by norm_num)
    norm_num at e1 e2 k1 k2
    linarith
  · intro hr
    refine ⟨2 * p, ?_⟩
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
    · have k1 := key 1 le_rfl
      norm_num at k1 ⊢
      rw [k1, h1, hr]
      ring
    · rw [key (m + 1) (by omega), key m hm]
      push_cast
      ring
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (p q r : ℝ), (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k = p * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 + q * (n : ℝ) + r) → ((∃ d : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → a (n + 1) = a n + d) ↔ r = 0)
